units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:44">Lam. R. to I, 15</cite> (expl. <he>סלה</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:44">ib.</cite>) <he>עבדי ס׳ וכ׳</he> (some ed. <cite ref="O01694"><he>סָאתֵי</he></cite> pl.) he made me like refuse before them.
Ib. בבר גמזא צווחין לס׳ סרקי (read סלותא; Ar. בברגיא … לסחותא סולתא) in Bar Gamza they call sweepings sallutha (that which is thrown away); v. סְחִיתָא.
